title: Last Light of June
description: Follow June’s last afternoon through sunset, woodland shadows and lantern light to the quiet threshold of the storm.

signs.text:
The last afternoon fields
Follow the warm light towards the ridge

The sunset ridge
Climb into the last sunlight

The shadowed woodland
Keep below the dark woodland branches

The lantern countryside
Use the lanterns to read the old stone passages

The storm’s quiet threshold
Cross the last dark terraces · the keeper waits beyond
